name: Hello Stranger
detailed_description:
Cam conducts his entire life from his electronically automated smart-home. Work, shopping, entertainment and most notably: socialising. Cam interacts with strangers on the platform Hello Stranger: a randomised video chatting application.

Eventually, he encounters a masked stranger with an altered voice. Unnerved, Cam leaves the call only to find the stranger has hacked his smart-home and locked him in. The Stranger tells Cam that he must win three rounds of games or it is ‘game over’. Viewers must make decisions and play the 3 games for Cam to survive but one wrong choice could lead to a grisly end.

This FMV psychological horror-thriller game features:

  • Choice-based mechanics and mini-games including 10 unique endings.

  • Two story modes: 

    - Cinema Mode: Limited games that only function with decision-making system – closer to an interactive film experience.

    - Game Mode: All games available with a variety of gameplay systems – a full FMV game experience.

  • Two game modes:

    - Timed Choices: A more immersive, pressured experience.

    - Paused Choices: For group play / audience participation during live streams.

  • A graphic Story Tree of all possible narrative branches. These branches unlock as the player progresses through the pool of 4 hours of filmed content, 16 mini games and 10 endings which all need to be seen to understand the full picture of 'Hello Stranger'.

  • Renowned acting talent, including George Blagden ('Vikings'), Danny Griffin ('Fate: The Winx Saga), Christina Wolfe ('FBI: International'), Laura Whitmore ('Queenie'), Kulvinder Ghir ('Goodness Gracious Me'), Yasmin Finney ('Heartstopper') and Derek Jacobi (Gladiator).

Paul Raschid - the writer-director, is one of the world's most prolific creatives in the FMV game format. His other titles include: 'The Complex', 'Five Dates', 'Ten Dates' and 'The Gallery'.

short_description: An FMV psychological horror-thriller. A man gets trapped in his home by a hacker who forces him to play three games to survive. You must play these games and make choices that determine his fate.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Arabic, Portuguese - Brazil, Italian, Korean, German, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
reviews:
“Paul Raschid has once again cemented himself as the master of FMV games with Hello Stranger.”
8/10 – Gamespew

“Hello Stranger hits the mark as an intense thriller with plenty of psychological horror to be enjoyed throughout its literal hundreds of branching narratives.”
10/10 – Gaming Pizza

“Hello Stranger is a glorious evolution of the FMV genre, mixing together interactive storytelling with contemporary themes and strong production values. It’s a game that respects its roots while pushing the format forward, offering a twisty, accessible, and genuinely entertaining experience.”
8/10 – Geekgasm
